instruction:
Two Storey Mixed Retail And Office Retrofit IFC With Revit Area Schedule CSV

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a two-storey mixed retail and office building, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a Revit area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 4 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, and 2 IfcSlab entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token retail at least 2 times and office at least 2 times.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit schedule export with exactly the headers category,area in that order and exactly 2 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains rows with these exact category and area values: retail=95 and office=95.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Revit 2027\Revit.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
